---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or a new video mode
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

A clear and concise description of what the problem is, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when..."

**Describe the solution you would like**

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you have considered**

Other approaches or workarounds you have tried.

**Which category does this fit?**

- [ ] New video mode (a new `videoType`)
- [ ] Improve an existing mode
- [ ] Pipeline / workflow improvement
- [ ] Studio UI / frontend
- [ ] API / render server
- [ ] Documentation

**Additional context**

Screenshots, mockups, references to other projects, or anything else that helps explain the request.
